radiusSource: Radius 0.439 +/- 0.003 solar radii from Luque et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 260655 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...664A.199L/abstract): 305,412 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.439 +/- 0.011 solar masses from Luque et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 260655 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...664A.199L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
